sources.verified_fact: The API returns crime-category identifiers for the requested data-set month.

sources.verified_fact: The force-list method supplies force identifiers; project scope adjustments must be declared separately.
sources.quality_effect: Prevents an endpoint membership rule from being mislabelled as full England-and-Wales coverage.

sources.verified_fact: Street-level outcomes can be queried by location, representative point or polygon; coverage limits remain explicit.
sources.quality_effect: Outcome coverage gaps are recorded instead of inferred as zero.

sources.verified_fact: The method lists months with street-crime data and force-level stop-and-search availability.
sources.quality_effect: Month availability can be checked before endpoint execution.

sources.source: Home Office police recorded crime and outcomes open data
sources.verified_fact: The official page provides Police Force Area, Community Safety Partnership and outcomes tables.
sources.quality_effect: Adds an official aggregate cross-check separate from street-level API results.

sources.source: ONS Police Force Area data tables
sources.verified_fact: Area-level tables support trend validation but are not parcel-level measurements.
sources.quality_effect: Preserves AREA_LEVEL_PROXY semantics.

sources.verified_fact: The live API reports 2026-05-01 as the latest street-crime data date.
sources.quality_effect: Locks the runtime test month to May 2026 and prevents querying a future unavailable month.

sources.quality_effect: Four-force month-to-month loss is recorded as missing coverage, never zero activity.

sources.quality_effect: The project denominator remains an explicit scope construction: exclude Northern Ireland and add BTP.

sources.source: MPS Stop and Search Dashboard Data

sources.quality_effect: Adds current operational context without being converted into a parcel safety score.

sources.quality_effect: Provides a current aggregate cross-check while preventing incompatible totals.

sources.verified_fact: The current workbook covers Jul 2024-Jun 2026 and carries an IT-disruption warning.
sources.quality_effect: Retained only as sensitive operational context; excluded from parcel scoring.

sources.quality_effect: Adds emergency-response context while forbidding interpretation as crime incidence or guaranteed parcel response time.

sources.quality_effect: Adds current force-capacity context; workforce totals are not treated as local crime risk or parcel safety.
